value.rationale: A complete natural classification of centrally symmetric hyperplane sections of every dimension of cube, identifying a rigid parallelotope exception and a sharp threshold for an interval of noncentral symmetric offsets. Unlike a routine count or arbitrary slice, it separates geometric center symmetry from combinatorial reconstruction and identifies all admissible offsets for each normal.
